name: Herbs And Plants
overview: Scripture reveals that God created herbs and plants as part of His good and orderly creation, commanding the earth to bring forth seed-bearing herbs and fruit trees, each according to its kind. These plants were given by God not only for human nourishment but also for the sustenance of all living creatures, demonstrating His provision and care for life on earth. The account in Genesis underscores the intentional design and blessing in the natural order, where herbs and plants serve as essential sources of food and life.
